rows.notes: The study is a short conference review paper (proceedings) that synthesises other literature on remote sensing for precision irrigation; it explicitly states that no datasets were generated or analysed. It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs, so Q1 is 'no' and all further questions are 'no'. The claimed effect (remote sensing enabling identification of irrigation timing/location via crop water stress, ET and soil moisture, leading to effective water use and reduced waste) is asserted narratively from cited sources only.

notes: Four-page proceedings review paper (Environ. Sci. Proc. 2022, 23, 31) with no original data; the Data Availability Statement confirms no datasets were generated or analysed. Text contains some duplicated/overlapping lines from PDF extraction on page 3 but is complete.
